user.title: Set up BabyEs
user.description: A local sleep and bottle diary. Everything is stored in Home Assistant and included in your backups.

data_description.name: Shown on the card and the device. Stays in your Home Assistant.

start.name: Start
start.description: When the sleep started. Leave empty for now.

stop_sleep.name: Stop sleep
stop_sleep.description: Ends the ongoing sleep period now.

breast_milk_ml.name: Breast milk
breast_milk_ml.description: Amount of breast milk in ml.

timestamp.name: Time
timestamp.description: When the bottle was given. Leave empty for now.

not_ready.message: BabyEs is not set up or still loading.

no_timezone.message: The time must include a time zone.

feed_future.message: A bottle cannot be more than one hour in the future.

sleep_future.message: Sleep cannot start or end in the future.

end_before_start.message: Wake-up must be after falling asleep.

too_long.message: A single sleep period cannot exceed 48 hours.

ongoing_too_old.message: An ongoing sleep cannot have started more than 48 hours ago.

cannot_reopen.message: A finished sleep period must keep its end time.

overlap.message: The period overlaps another sleep period.

already_sleeping.message: A sleep is already in progress.

not_sleeping.message: There is no ongoing sleep to stop.

amount_invalid.message: Amounts must be whole numbers between 0 and {max} ml.

note_too_long.message: The note can be at most {max} characters.

not_found.message: The entry was not found. Reload the history.

conflict.message: The entry was changed on another device. Open it again.

corrupt.message: The diary file has an invalid format. Restore from a backup.
